name: 説明と二つの選択欄を持つ国・言語設定
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Targeted correction of LH07-0107. Image 1 is the original Amazon panel crop and controls the row anatomy and landscape composition. Image 2 is the landscape Lighthouse candidate to edit and controls output framing. Image 3 controls the exact Japanese wording, Meiryo roles, forest green action and Lighthouse styling. Image 4 is approved style guidance. Make the final canvas a tight landscape panel at a 390:302 ratio (about 1.29:1), matching the framing of Images 1 and 3. No portrait page, no large blank area below, no outer card, toolbar, status bar, footer or added chrome. Preserve exactly these six strings and no others: どの国・地域と言語で利用しますか？; 国・地域; 米国; 言語; 英語; 完了. Keep the question on one line at about x=20,y=25. Keep two separate white outlined selector rows around x=20,w=350 and about70px high: first around y=56, second around y=138, with a modest gap. The first row keeps the small US flag before 米国 and a right chevron; the second keeps 英語 and a right chevron. Place the forest-green full-width 完了 action around x=20,y=244,w=350,h=44. Preserve the Japanese preview’s exact Meiryo typography, weights, line heights, and wrapping. Keep the text legible and comfortable, using the layout in Image 3 as calibration. Keep neutral fine outlines and slate chevrons. Do not add a title, duplicate row, extra label or effect. The panel should occupy almost the full landscape canvas with only the same small white margins as Image 3.
reviewNotes: Reviewed at matched 390x302. Landscape framing and exact six labels are correct. Vertical rhythm remains compressed: question starts about20px too low, rows are about3-4px short, and gap before action is about18px too tight. Preserve exact labels, flag, chevrons, colors and typography while increasing rhythm. Not complete or owner accepted.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
